clues.title: Letter to Paul, 1961
clues.text:
My dear husband,

Twelve years married and I still miss you every day you are away. **Léa** keeps asking when her father will be home.

Yours,
*Marie*

clues.title: Birth notice, 1953
clues.text: **Le Matin — Births.** Mr and Mrs Paul Dubois are pleased to announce the birth of their daughter, Léa, on 4 March.

tutorial.text: Welcome, detective. The names on the board belong to one family. Your job: link them into a family tree using the clues on the left.
Marie calls Paul her husband. Select the Married tool.
Click Marie, then Paul. A dot appears between them: that is their couple.
The letter mentions Léa as their daughter. Select the Child tool, click the dot, then click Léa.
When you think the tree is complete, press Check.
